INSERT INTO message_reads (room_id, user_id, last_read_message_id)
               SELECT $1, $2, $3
               WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                   FROM message_reads mr
                   JOIN messages new ON new.id = $3
                   JOIN messages old ON old.id = mr.last_read_message_id
                   WHERE mr.room_id = $1
                     AND mr.user_id = $2
                     AND (new.created_at, new.id) <= (old.created_at, old.id)
               )
               ON CONFLICT (room_id, user_id) DO UPDATE
               SET last_read_message_id = EXCLUDED.last_read_message_id,
                   updated_at = now()
               WHERE message_reads.last_read_message_id IS NULL
                  OR (SELECT (created_at, id) FROM messages mnew WHERE mnew.id = EXCLUDED.last_read_message_id)
                     > (SELECT (created_at, id) FROM messages mold WHERE mold.id = message_reads.last_read_message_id)
